requirements_summary: Workload: outbound SDR chat agents with tool-calling for CRM/email/calendar actions.
Latency targets: streaming start-of-response <200ms p50, partials delivered sub-500ms p95; end-to-end tool-call roundtrip <1s (including webhook/third-party).
Throughput: target 200-500 concurrent agents for Q3; design for bursts up to 1000 concurrent sessions.
Model prefs: preference for performant open models with tool-calling hooks; want verified performance profiles from Redwood catalog.
Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper model when capacity constrained, with configurable policy.
Reliability: >=99.9% availability for agent-facing endpoints; guaranteed ordering/at-least-once semantics for tool calls and idempotency keys.
Observability: per-route latency breakdowns, token-level cost, tracing for tool-calls, retry metrics.
Data security: SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, audit logs for tool-calls, EU data residency for EU customers.
POC success criteria: streaming p95 <500ms, tool-call success >=99%, acceptable cost per session vs baseline.
